adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that all other OAuth integrations (Google Calendar, HubSpot, Lark, Office365, Webex, Zoho Bigin, Zoho CRM, Zoom) were updated to use the new `refreshOAuthTokens` helper function for credential sync support. However, in packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts, the code at line 73 shows a direct `fetch` call to 'https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token' without wrapping it in `refreshOAuthTokens`. This is inconsistent with the pattern applied to all other integrations and means Salesforce credentials won't use the CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT feature that was added for all other integrations. This is a real defect in the implementation of the credential sync feature.
